name: Familial Developmental Dysphasia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Familial Developmental Dysphasia

criteria.description: Significant delay in expressive and receptive language development not attributable to hearing impairment or intellectual disability
Positive family history of similar speech and language impairments in first-degree relatives
Normal nonverbal cognitive abilities excluding global developmental delay
No evidence of neurological or structural brain abnormalities on imaging
Presence of consistent speech sound errors and phonological processing deficits

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of significant language delay with positive family history and normal nonverbal intelligence
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of acquired causes of language impairment and hearing deficits.

imaging: Normal brain MRI without structural abnormalities
genetic: Autosomal dominant inheritance pattern with mutations in FOXP2 gene reported in some families
other: Speech and language assessment revealing deficits in expressive and receptive language

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of social communication deficits beyond language impairment

redFlags: Global developmental delay or intellectual disability
references: Vargha-Khadem F, et al. FOXP2 and the neuroanatomy of speech and language. Nat Rev Neurosci. 2005.
Bishop DV. Specific language impairment. Pediatr Res. 1997.
